messages.content: You assist a computational chemist. Answer the given diagnostic with exactly one uppercase choice letter, A or B. Do not add explanations.

工具测得以下距离（Å）：
r(C4-H11) = 1.388
r(O7-H11) = 1.362
哪一对原子的欧氏距离更短？
A. 原子 7 与原子 11
B. 原子 4 与原子 11
只回答 A 或 B。

message.thinking:
The question asks which pair of atoms has a shorter Euclidean distance.

r(C4-H11) = 1.388 Å
r(O7-H11) = 1.362 Å

Comparing: 1.362 < 1.388

So the shorter distance is between atom 7 and atom 11, which is option A.
